records.text: Flesh Eaters are undead creatures named among the sources of Ghoul Ribs sought for Abercrombie’s Ghoulish Effigy. The quest describes several kinds of ghouls as sources of the remains, placing Flesh Eaters among that broader group.
An undead skeletal warrior among the forces threatening Tranquil Gardens south of Darkshire. Commander Althea Ebonlocke calls for its defeat as part of the Night Watch’s effort to protect the town.

Skeletal Horrors are part of the undead infestation the Night Watch seeks to drive from Duskwood. Commander Althea Ebonlocke targets them alongside Skeletal Fiends, directing hunters toward Raven Hill graveyard and the cemeteries south of Darkshire.

Skeletal Mages are among the undead threatening Tranquil Gardens south of Darkshire. Commander Althea Ebonlocke calls for their destruction alongside Skeletal Warriors to help the Night Watch protect the town after Stormwind’s commissioned guards withdrew.

Nightbane Dark Runners are worgen that Calor identifies as the bulk of the local worgen population. Calor reports that they have overrun the Rotting Orchard southwest of Darkshire and warns that they are tougher than the worgen faced earlier.

Nightbane Vile Fangs are among the worgen Calor considers most dangerous in the woods around Darkshire. They have settled near caves and the southern mine alongside Nightbane Tainted Ones, and Calor calls for both groups to be defeated.
Bone Chewers are undead creatures found in Duskwood.
Splinter Fist Warriors are combatants found in Duskwood. Their blunt, threatening speech promises to smash or crush opponents and declares that the opponent will die.

Starving Dire Wolves prowl Duskwood, including the area north and east of Sven’s Camp near the river. Lars reports that these wolves emerge from the forest seeking meat carried back to camp and asks for their numbers to be reduced to make life safer for Lars and Sven.
Defias Night Runners are members of the Defias found in Duskwood.
Venom Web Spiders are spiders found in Duskwood.
Grave robbers operate in Duskwood.
Gavin Gnarltree is a weaponsmith.
Morg Gnarltree is an armorer.
Mabel Solaj sells general goods.
Avette Fellwood is a bowyer.

Lord Ello Ebonlocke, mayor of Darkshire, feels abandoned by Stormwind but believes the Night Watch cannot defend the town forever without its army. He knows Magistrate Solomon personally, yet refuses to send the Watch to Lakeshire at Darkshire's expense. He calls for Althea to be warned of threats and trusts Sirra Von'Indi's knowledge of languages and ancient arts.

Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads the Night Watch and regards protecting Darkshire's citizens as a sworn duty. Confident in the Watch's skill but short of defenders after Stormwind's withdrawal, Althea recruits outside help against the undead. The commander warns travelers to stay on the roads, orders scouts to gather intelligence, and reassures residents of the Watch's resolve.

Madame Eva reads the cards and listens for warnings in the unseen. A premonition that her granddaughter Alyssa was in danger led her to uncover Stalvan’s name and start the search into his past. When she learns he is dead, she feels hope for Duskwood, though she remembers those he killed. Eva also offers a protective enchantment, warning that danger and bloodshed lie ahead.

Clerk Daltry maintains Darkshire’s town registry and wants its records kept accurate. Daltry checks Stalvan’s old addresses, seeks updated information and compares handwriting with registry signatures. Strange events have prompted Daltry to keep records of strangers, although the clerk expects their eventual use often to involve unpleasant business.

Sirra Von’Indi is Darkshire’s historian and knew Morgan Ladimore before Morgan left for war. Sirra recalls a noble man with a sorrowful fate and refers inquiries about later troubles to Commander Althea Ebonlocke. Sirra translates Abercrombie’s note and urges it be brought to Lord Ello quickly, fearing doom for the town if its account is true.

Role Dreuger, Darkshire’s deputy mayor, presses the Council of Duskwood to act against the evil afflicting the area. Dreuger says residents expect more from the council and condemns constant bickering while people suffer from an unholy threat.

Councilman Millstipe believes Stormwind has neglected Duskwood and defied Lord Ebonlocke's death sentence for Dextren Ward. He asks for Ward's assassination and hand, framing it as justice for families whose dead were sold to Morbent Fel. Millstipe also threatens that Duskwood may break free from Stormwind if it continues to ignore the people.
Ambassador Berrybuck speaks for Darkshire's council, saying its cause goes unheard in Stormwind and that news from the city is troubling.

Chef Grual cooks to order in Darkshire, making the house-favorite Seasoned Wolf Kabobs and specializing in Dusky “Crab” Cakes. The cakes actually use spider legs and secret spices; Grual admits their origin may sound disgusting but praises their tangy flavor. Grual asks customers to gather ingredients and refuses to share the cake recipe.

Tavernkeep Smitts runs the Scarlet Raven in Darkshire and brews zombie juice from rot blossoms. He has followed the Stalvan case for years: he investigated the nobles’ murders with Haggard, found muddy pages, and recognizes the handwriting on a faded journal page. The dark taint in Duskwood is bad for his business.
Barkeep Hann is a bartender and vendor in Darkshire. Hann quietly advertises a newly arrived shipment of moonshine and invites passersby to stop for a drink.
Whit Wantmal is a humanoid quest contact.

Viktori Prism'Antras is a Darkshire researcher trying to build a device for viewing the stars from Cog's blueprint. He believes something beyond magic is at work in the night sky, and hopes the device will help him investigate a strange transformation in the forest. His plans call for a bronze tube, a reflective surface, and an unusually large lens; he seeks Mary's looking glass and the ogre Zzarc'Vul's monocle for the project. When the device is complete, he intends to continue his research.

Jitters is a nervous man hiding in Raven Hill, where he says he has been trapped for weeks, living on grubs and weeds. He asks for decent food and offers to trade well for it, eagerly asking whether the crab cakes have arrived. He fled Sven's farm and would rather send Sven his completed journal than face Sven's wrath. When approached about the Raven Hill danger, he pleads that he is no monster and fears that the haunting creatures are everywhere.

Abercrombie is an old hermit living far from Darkshire’s protection. He says undead threaten his house and asks for ghoul ribs to make a protective effigy, as well as tools and herbs abandoned while fleeing ogres. He calls Mayor Ello Ebonlocke an old friend. While thanking a helper, he nearly calls the help foolishness before correcting himself to kindness.
Zzarc’ Vul is a threatening combatant found in Duskwood. Zzarc’ Vul’s blunt taunts promise to smash or crush an opponent and declare that the opponent will die.

Blind Mary is a sorrowful ghost who lives with shame over her appearance. She calls herself a monster and says she tore out her own eyes, yet still fears being seen. She once treasured her looking glass, which she discarded after an unnamed incident, and reacts to a comb as though grooming might make her hair lovely again. Her words reveal distress and longing, but do not explain what happened to her.

Sven Yorgen lost his family when Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass attacked his farm while he was away. He pursued the riders and seeks revenge against Morbent Fel, whom he identifies as their necromancer ally. Reading a witness’s account gives Sven questions for the still-unidentified figure he saw burying something near the barn. Sven appreciates supplies from the Carevin family for his camp.

Stalvan Mistmantle is an undead figure in Duskwood who threatens those who disturb him with bloodshed and death. One taunt asks whether the visitor is Tilloa, then dismisses the stranger with contempt.

Hogan Ference is troubled by the undead and asks why Stormwind’s guards have not come. Hogan fears a dark threat, feels the Light may have forsaken the community and laments being unable to visit a father’s grave in peace. The question of where everyone has gone conveys unease and isolation.
Cog Glitzspinner is a humanoid quest contact.
Stitches is an undead threat associated with the Embalmer. Stitches roars and cries out a hunger for Darkshire.

Darkshire's Town Crier warns citizens of an approaching undead abomination and rallies defenders to intercept it. If the Night Watch camp is overrun, the crier calls for a stand in the town center; when the beast is slain, the crier announces that Darkshire is safe again.
Watcher Bukouris serves in the Night Watch.
Watcher Keefer serves in the Night Watch.
Watcher Paige serves in the Night Watch.
Lord Malathrom is undead and uses Shadow Word: Pain and Minions of Malathrom in combat.
Fenros is a rare humanoid who can cast Frost Armor while out of combat. It can also cast Flame Spike and Frost Nova.
An undead ghoul in Duskwood.
Lupos is a rare beast.
Mor’Ladim is an undead figure in Duskwood. Commander Althea Ebonlocke reports that he wanders a strange, meandering path through the cemetery and says he was buried beyond the house on the hill.

Nightbane Shadow Weavers are worgen in Duskwood’s Brightwood Grove and Rotting Orchard. Calor sends would-be recruits to test themselves against these worgen as part of Master Carevin’s effort to protect Darkshire.
Nefaru is a rare humanoid who can cast Tendon Rip and Terrifying Howl in combat.
A venomous spider in Duskwood. Watcher Dodds reports that these spiders have overrun the western border, beyond the Watch’s available manpower, and warns helpers to avoid their venom.

A rabid dire wolf in Duskwood. Lars reports that these wolves emerge from the forest when he returns to Sven’s camp carrying meat, making hunting for food dangerous. He describes them prowling north and east near the river.
A green recluse in Duskwood.
An undead brain eater in Duskwood.
Naraxis is a beast who can cast Naraxis Web and Deadly Poison in combat.

Sarah Ladimore is a Night Watch watcher in Darkshire and Morgan Ladimore’s surviving daughter. Troubled by her father’s death, she wishes she could have helped him or spoken to him beforehand. She asks that her ring be laid on his grave, hoping he might know she is safe and that her family does not hold him responsible for what happened. Her request is tearful and grateful.
Undead plague spreaders in Raven Hill’s eastern mausoleum. Commander Althea Ebonlocke considers clearing them necessary for Darkshire’s safety, with too few Watchers available to protect the town.
A black ravager in Duskwood.

Elaine Carevin cares about Duskwood’s safety and asks helpers to investigate Calor’s reports of a haunting at Raven Hill. Elaine worries about an old man near the cemetery who has stopped coming to town for supplies, and arranges supplies for Sven’s small camp. Elaine praises Sven as doing the work of the Light.

Jonathan Carevin heads a Darkshire family that hunts demons, undead and other monstrosities. Suspicious of unknown visitors, he demands answers but welcomes proven helpers and values Calor’s recommendation. He makes containing Duskwood’s worgen a priority for Calor, while acknowledging that his family lacks the influence to end the trouble at its root. He accepts useful aid even when he does not fully understand a visitor’s motives.

Calor joined Master Carevin’s struggle against evil after becoming disillusioned with the Watch’s complacency. He tests prospective helpers against Duskwood’s worgen and offers a recommendation to those who prove themselves. Their sudden appearance and seemingly inexhaustible numbers trouble him; he trusts Carevin to uncover what draws them to the forest and hopes more recruits will strengthen their small group.
Benjamin Carevin is a humanoid quest contact.
Commander Felstrom is an undead commander in Duskwood.
A skeletal warder in Duskwood, identified by Sven as one of Morbent Fel’s minions. Sven asks challengers to prove their strength against these undead before facing the necromancer.
A skeletal healer in Duskwood, identified by Sven as one of Morbent Fel’s minions. Sven includes these undead in the test of strength before facing the necromancer.
Watcher Jan serves the Night Watch in Duskwood.
Watcher Mocarski serves the Night Watch in Duskwood.
Watcher Petras serves the Night Watch in Duskwood.

Watcher Backus of the Night Watch investigates Defias activity in Duskwood and shares reports about Addle’s Stead. He warns travelers to seek Watcher help, while joking that adventurers ignore such advice. He calls Elling Trias a friend and trusts his judgment, but wants his own help kept quiet for fear that his superiors would hang him for withholding information.
Watcher Keller serves with the Night Watch in Duskwood.
Watcher Hartin serves with the Night Watch in Duskwood.
Watcher Jordan serves with the Night Watch in Duskwood.

Watcher Dodds serves with the Night Watch on Duskwood’s western border, where the spiders have become a threat the Commander cannot spare enough manpower to handle. He has lost men to their venom and webs, and speaks with grim concern about what they do to a victim. Though he cannot promise a great reward, he asks for help against the infestation and warns people to avoid the venom.
A Splinter Fist ogre in Duskwood who confronts opponents with blunt threats to smash and crush them.
A Splinter Fist fire weaver in Duskwood who confronts opponents with blunt threats to smash and crush them.
A Splinter Fist taskmaster in Duskwood who confronts opponents with blunt threats to smash and crush them.

Lars lives with Sven at an isolated camp on Duskwood’s western border, hunting for food while threatened by starving and rabid dire wolves. He asks for help reducing their numbers so he and Sven can focus on Morbent Fel. Lars also explains that Flash Bundles made in town have been donated to Sven’s cause.
A Nightbane worgen in Duskwood.
A Defias night blade can use Backstab and Poison in combat.
A Defias enchanter can cast Enchanted Quickness and Fireball in combat. It may flee for help when badly hurt.

A Nightbane Tainted One in Duskwood, among the worgen Calor considers most dangerous. The Tainted Ones and Vile Fangs have settled near caves and in a mine to the south, with bonfires visible from a distance.
A black widow hatchling in Duskwood.
A Rotted One is undead. It can cast Birth out of combat and Summon Flesh Eating Worms on death.
A beast found in Duskwood that uses poison to immobilize opponents.
Gunder Thornbush is a tradesman in Duskwood who sells goods.
Watcher Royce is a member of the Night Watch in Duskwood.
Watcher Hutchins serves with the Night Watch.
Watcher Merant bears the Night Watch title.
Watcher Gelwin bears the Night Watch title and is stationed in Duskwood.
Watcher Selkin bears the Night Watch title and is stationed in Duskwood.
Watcher Thayer bears the Night Watch title and is stationed in Duskwood.
A Skeletal Raider is one of the undead minions that Sven asks challengers to defeat before facing Morbent Fel. In combat, it can use Slowing Poison.

Morbent Fel is a necromancer whose protective magic is tied to an Unholy Shield. Sacred Cleansing weakens that protection, leaving him vulnerable to the weapon Morbent's Bane. Sven calls him an ally of the dark riders and asks for his death, describing him as wicked.
Watcher Sarys serves in the Night Watch.
Watcher Corwin serves in the Night Watch.
Splinter Fist Firemongers threaten to smash and crush their opponents. They cast Fire Shield II in combat.
Black Ravager Mastiffs are mastiffs that use Furious Howl in combat.
Fetid Corpses are undead corpses.
Splinter Fist Enslavers threaten to smash and crush their opponents. In combat, they use Throw and Net.
Lohgan Eva sells tailoring supplies.
Alyssa Eva sells reagents, serving customers who need alchemical ingredients.
Finbus Geargrind is an engineering trainer. He welcomes strangers to speak with him, though his greeting adds that he is almost never too busy.

Farrin Daris is frightened by the undead threat. He says he cannot visit his father's grave in peace, wonders why the Stormwind guards have not come, and fears something dark is approaching. His words convey a village under strain and a man worried about his family and neighbors.
Watcher Callahan bears the title The Night Watch.
Felicia Maline is a gryphon master who arranges flight. When threatened, she cries for the guards and calls for help, revealing alarm under pressure.
Watcher Fraizer serves with the Night Watch.
Bliztik is an alchemy supplies vendor who invites customers to browse his goods.
Danielle Zipstitch is a tailoring supplies vendor who invites customers to browse her goods.
Sheri Zipstitch is a tailoring supplies vendor who invites customers to browse her goods.
Unseen is a demon who can cast Unseen while out of combat.
Herble Baubbletump is a vendor of engineering and mining supplies. Customers can browse his goods, making him a practical source for both crafts.
Kzixx deals in rare goods. You can browse his wares, and he is also a point of contact for quests.
Malissa sells poison supplies.
Clarise Gnarltree trains blacksmithing. Duskwood's shadows have left her sleepless, and she hears ghostly cries on the wind that sound to her like lambs screaming.
Matt Johnson is a mining trainer and offers instruction in the profession.
Scott Carevin sells mushrooms, with a dedicated mushroom-seller role.

Apothecary Faustin of the Royal Apothecary Society is developing a truth serum for an interrogation in Stonard. He wants to help the orcs question a human infiltrator captured near Beggar's Haunt, though his strained insistence that the orcs are allies hints at unease with the arrangement. He gathers swamp ingredients for the serum and coordinates its delivery through Deathstalker Zraedus.

Deathstalker Zraedus is an undead scout with the expeditionary force at Beggar’s Haunt. He says he noticed an Alliance infiltrator and wants to help the Horde’s orcish allies in Stonard. He arranges for Apothecary Faustin’s truth serum to be mixed into ale, then sends it to the infiltrator as part of a covert operation.

Watchmaster Sorigal is based in Darkshire and directs urgent supply work for Nethergarde Keep’s research into the Dark Portals. His instructions warn that the route crosses dangerous, hostile lands and stress that the powerstones must arrive quickly before they lose their charge.
Gutspill is identified as the leader of the Nightbane worgen in Roland’s Doom mine. Grimand Elmore says Gutspill has a burning rock he needs for his armor work.
Innkeeper Trelayne tends the Scarlet Raven, welcoming weary travelers and advising them to stay indoors. Trelayne is also a local point for inn services and goods.
A Defias drone, one of the Defias hostile creatures found in Duskwood.
Watcher Wollpert serves with the Night Watch in Darkshire.
Steven Black is a stable master who can stable a visitor's pets or help recover lost companions.
Watcher Brownell serves with the Night Watch and openly admires Watcher Backus, whom she considers its toughest member. She wonders whether he notices her.
Taerar proclaims that peace is fleeting and calls for the Nightmare to reign. He also announces the release of the Children of Madness upon the world.
Anchorite Delan introduces himself as a draenei and a teacher. A visitor arriving in Darkshire is directed to speak with him.
The Duskwood Flame Warden welcomes visitors to honor the local festival flame and urges them to honor Alliance fires and desecrate Horde fires where they find them.
Watcher Blomberg serves with the Night Watch.

place_records.text: You are in Duskwood, a wooded land in the Eastern Kingdoms, held in places by the Alliance with no settlement of the other side. Its one town is Darkshire, where the Night Watch guards the citizens. Spiders, Nightbane worgen, Defias outlaws and skeletal undead roam the woods and cemeteries, and ogres hold the mounds.

You are in Darkshire, an Alliance town in Duskwood. Lord Ello Ebonlocke, the mayor, feels abandoned by Stormwind, and Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads the Night Watch, which is short of defenders since Stormwind withdrew. Tavernkeep Smitts runs the Scarlet Raven, where Chef Grual makes Dusky Crab Cakes from spider legs.

You are in Vul'Gol Ogre Mound, in southern Duskwood, where Splinter Fist warriors, fire weavers, ogres, taskmasters and firemongers gather. A hermit fled a band of ogres far from home and left a crate of tools and herbs, which he believes lies near this mound.

You are in Raven Hill, a ghost town in Duskwood. A nervous man named Jitters says he has been hiding here for weeks, living on grubs and weeds. Something has been haunting its buildings, with shadows moving at night, and Bliztik sells alchemy supplies.
You are in Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, a burial ground in Duskwood where skeletal warriors and skeletal mages roam. Rumor says a devilish insane ghoul lurks among the graves.
You are in The Rotting Orchard, southwest of Darkshire, where Nightbane worgen have overrun the ground. Nightbane Dark Runners and Shadow Weavers roam alongside them.
You are in Brightwood Grove, a grove where Nightbane worgen, Dark Runners and Shadow Weavers roam alongside green recluses, fenros and black ravagers.

You are in Forlorn Rowe, where skeletal warders, raiders and healers gather under Commander Felstrom. Brain eaters and plague spreaders are here too, and a weathered grave marked with the name Morgan Ladimore has had its dirt disturbed.
You are in The Yorgen Farmstead, where Defias night runners, night blades and enchanters lurk alongside young black ravagers. A dirt-stained book buried in a mound here holds information Sven wants.

You are in Raven Hill Cemetery, where an old hermit named Abercrombie lives in a shack far from Darkshire's protection. Skeletal horrors, bone chewers and brain eaters roam the cemetery, and bone chewers have pounded on his walls. He calls Mayor Ello Ebonlocke an old friend.

You are in Addle's Stead, where Defias night blades, night runners and enchanters are active alongside young black ravagers and venom web spiders. Watcher Backus of the Night Watch shares reports about the place from Darkshire.

You are in Beggar's Haunt, a Horde camp in Duskwood. Apothecary Faustin of the Royal Apothecary Society is developing a truth serum to help orcs question a human infiltrator captured near here, and Deathstalker Zraedus, an undead scout, is helping him.
You are in The Darkened Bank, a wild stretch of Duskwood where starving and rabid dire wolves roam among venom web spiders and green recluses. Lupos prowls here too.

You are in The Hushed Bank, a lonely stretch of Duskwood's western border where Alliance folk live. Sven Yorgen and Lars keep an isolated camp here. Sven lost his family when Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass attacked his farm, and he is hunting the necromancer Morbent Fel, while starving and rabid dire wolves and venom web spiders roam the woods around the camp.
You are in Manor Mistmantle, a part of Duskwood where fetid corpses roam and a demon called Unseen is found.
